inquiries.name: Siddharth Rao
inquiries.problemStatement: We process 40+ government and private RFP tenders monthly and need an AI Document Assistant to extract eligibility criteria and BOQ tables.
inquiries.aiSummary: Priority B2B Document Assistant + Tender Workflow portal. Estimated 6-week delivery using Akviora AI structured extraction.

suggestions.suggestionText: Automate WhatsApp dispatch updates and POD (Proof of Delivery) PDF extraction into our ERP ledger.
suggestions.businessGoal: Eliminate 3 hours of daily manual dispatch status calls and speed up invoice release.
suggestions.aiAssessment: High-ROI workflow: Combine Akviora Document Assistant (for POD OCR extraction) with a webhook automation bridge to trigger instant WhatsApp status notifications and ERP ledger entries.

suggestions.suggestionText: An interactive onboarding assistant that reads our technical API docs and generates starter code snippets for new developers.
suggestions.businessGoal: Reduce developer time-to-first-API-call from 2 days to under 15 minutes.
suggestions.aiAssessment: Ideal fit for a grounded Knowledge Assistant connected to your OpenAPI spec and markdown docs, paired with copy-ready code blocks and sandbox validation.

suggestions.suggestionText: Multi-site construction material rate comparison and automated PO variance alert before approval.
suggestions.businessGoal: Prevent procurement cost overruns across 6 active residential towers.
suggestions.aiAssessment: Matches our Cost Management platform architecture: real-time BOQ threshold checks with mobile-first two-tap executive approval flows.

blueprints.bottleneck: Sales reps spend 4 hours a day answering repetitive technical spec questions and manually preparing PDF quotes.
blueprints.diagnosis: High friction between inbound buyer intent and technical quote generation due to fragmented PDF catalogs.

workflowSteps.title: Unified Spec Indexing
workflowSteps.detail: Ingest all equipment spec sheets and pricing tiers into a verified Akviora Knowledge Assistant.

workflowSteps.title: Conversational Buyer Qualification
workflowSteps.detail: Sales Assistant captures operating requirements, volume, and delivery location on web and WhatsApp.

workflowSteps.title: Automated Quote Draft & CRM Sync
workflowSteps.detail: Generate a pre-filled draft quote and notify the assigned regional sales engineer for 1-click approval.

workflowSteps.title: Automated Follow-Up Sequence
workflowSteps.detail: Trigger polite 3-day and 7-day check-ins with instant calendar booking links.

blueprints.estimatedEfficiencyGain: 16+ hours saved per rep weekly · 3.2x faster quote turnaround
